title: Edit a lab order
summary: Change an order’s services, doctor, lab, due date, notes or urgent flag.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Search for the order
steps.details: By patient, job, lab or order number.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.details: Click it in the list. Its details open on the right.

steps.title: Review the order
steps.details: It opens on Review. “Edit” on each row (or the steps above) takes you to change the patient, services or laboratory; “Back to review” returns here.

steps.title: Due date
steps.details: Shown once the order is sent; if the lab gives a new date, change it here.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.details: The stage is not changed here: use “Move to…” or “Other stage…”.
